title: How to Get Started in Real Estate with NO Money 💰💰💰 - Grant Cardone
summary: A real estate promoter lists ways to buy property with no money of your own and invites viewers to a free extended training.

assertions.quote: you don't need money to buy a deal trust me you don't

verdicts.note: Lenders require down payments on investment property; no-money deals depend on partners, sellers or a track record most beginners lack.

assertions.quote: good real estate will always find money
if you know them and they trust you and you have a great deal they will fund it for you
i know guys that are getting deals done right now 100 financing uh they get the senior debt
you could be a little off and still make money on stuff

verdicts.note: Leveraged property bought badly can and often does lose money, as foreclosure waves show; early wins in rising markets do not generalize.

assertions.quote: cheapest money in the world is family and friends

verdicts.note: Family loans can cost less than hard money, but they are not free, and a failed deal puts relationships at risk as well as money.
